test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "**judiciously**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Judiciously**" means **performing an action wisely and carefully**. 

 
 
• **Example: ***The judge** judiciously** solved the case.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the appropriate option is "judiciously". 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Effectively** - usefully.

 
 
• **Example:** *My teacher advised me **effectively***.
 
 
 
• **Hopefully** - want something to be true.
 
 
• **Example:** *Amy thinks that she would win the prize **hopefully.** *
 
 
 
• **Carelessly** - without any care. 
 
 
• **Example:** *Tony lost his stationary **carelessly**.*
